from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,sys,platform
root=Path('/home/jacob/hamon-testpilot-witness-0553c522566e')
variant=sys.argv[1]
assert variant in ('original','candidate')
source=root/variant/'web-demo';output=root/(variant+'-browser')
def pins():
 return {p.relative_to(source).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(source.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
before=pins()
environment={**os.environ,'TMPDIR':str(root/'tmp'),'TESTPILOT_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE':str(root/'browser-tools/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs'),'TESTPILOT_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE':'/snap/bin/chromium'}
command=['node',str(source/'tools/check_browser.mjs'),str(source),str(output)]
p=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=environment,capture_output=True,timeout=90)
(root/(variant+'-browser.stdout')).write_bytes(p.stdout)
(root/(variant+'-browser.stderr')).write_bytes(p.stderr)
after=pins()
r={'host':platform.node(),'node':subprocess.check_output(['node','--version']).decode().strip(),'variant':variant,'command':command,'cwd':str(root),'exit':p.returncode,'before':before,'after':after,'source_unchanged':before==after,'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'stderr':p.stderr.decode(),'browser_receipt':json.loads((output/'receipt.json').read_text()) if (output/'receipt.json').exists() else None}
(root/(variant+'-receiving.json')).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
